result: You may wonder how to borrow care if your history has no trustworthy people in it, and the answer is that you can still do it. If it helps, use a remembered person, or imagine an adult who intends to take good care of you, and ask what that person would say or do given your actual history, limitations, and options. If warmth feels out of reach, start with the least cruel response you can believe. And once you find one usable sentence or action, try it instead of repeating the exercise in different words.
